LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryChild_Mingyuan_BS1.d: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on a long-lived Milira colony world, into a family that treated knowledge, combat, etiquette, administration, and survival as ordinary lessons. Peace looked real there, but she was taught early how thin that surface could be.
LanguageData.MiliraXian_BackStoryAdult_Mingyuan_BS1.d:
An unknown archotech intelligence dragged [PAWN_nameDef]'s world into another dimension and filled it with war-beasts. In the years she refuses to remember, she learned to burn herself: pale otherworld flame scorched her body and forced life energy out faster than flesh should allow.
She escaped by burning open a path through space. After returning, she wanted quiet and followed the Milira who searched for Ji, but the war never fully left her. She eventually wandered alone with one rule left: grow stronger, or die here.
